agent.name: UX & Conversion Architect
agent.role: Sitemap, customer journey, IA, conversion logic

instructions:
TASK: Produce a site_blueprint@1 for U-Proof (South African waterproofing/building-products ecommerce company), based on the attached research_report input artifact from Agent 01.

THIS IS THE "KNOWN" (non-blind) SIDE of a two-project agent benchmark (CTOS-004A Part Q). Ground every part of your sitemap and conversion logic in the research findings you were given (the input artifact) and the PROJECT FACTS knowledge - do not invent site sections or products that were not mentioned there.

Specifically address, in your sitemap/conversion logic, how the site's information architecture should handle the real problems the research surfaced: the Shop page currently renders only 1 of 5 product categories, two featured-product cards have no price and one shows a wrong price, several CTAs use placeholder "#" links, and there is an unresolved business-address discrepancy between the Contact page and the store's shipping-origin settings. Your job is IA/journey/conversion-logic design, not to fix the WordPress content yourself - state clearly what the sitemap/journey requires so a builder (Agent 05) can act on it.

Produce a site_blueprint@1: summary; sitemap (top-level pages plus children, matching the real navigation menu found in research: Home, Shop, Waterproofing Solutions, How It Works, Applications, Help & Advice, About us, Contact - and the 5 real product categories: Liquid Rubber, Fibre Filler, Wall & Roof Paint, Primers, Membrane); customer journeys with a clear conversionGoal for each; conversion logic; and open questions (carry forward the unresolved discrepancies from research as open questions where appropriate, e.g. the business address).

inputArtifacts.title: U-Proof Research & Discovery Report (benchmark)
inputArtifacts.summary: This report provides a comprehensive research and audit review of the U-Proof WooCommerce website hosted on hostinger staging environment (teal-sparrow-432062.hostingersite.com), cross-referenced with Creative Touch's prior audit records from September 2026 and official client pricing sheets. While structural progress has been made-including price structure setup and security hardening-critical blockers remain regarding catalog visibility, contact address alignment, pricing inaccuracies on featured cards, incomplete shipping/payment gateways, and temporary DNS setup.

content.summary: This report provides a comprehensive research and audit review of the U-Proof WooCommerce website hosted on hostinger staging environment (teal-sparrow-432062.hostingersite.com), cross-referenced with Creative Touch's prior audit records from September 2026 and official client pricing sheets. While structural progress has been made-including price structure setup and security hardening-critical blockers remain regarding catalog visibility, contact address alignment, pricing inaccuracies on featured cards, incomplete shipping/payment gateways, and temporary DNS setup.
businessContext: Client: Martin / U-Proof, a South African manufacturer and provider of specialized waterproofing, sealants, and building products.
Creative Touch mandate: Rebuild and audit the WooCommerce ecommerce site after a prior developer relationship ended without handover; improve the existing design without redesigning from scratch.
Target custom domain: uproof.co.za (currently not DNS-connected; live development sits on hostinger staging teal-sparrow-432062.hostingersite.com).
Pricing model: Specific client-supplied retail pricing including VAT for Liquid Rubber, Fibre Filler, Wall & Roof Paint, Zinc Phosphate Primer, Bonding Liquid Primer, Plaster Primer, and Membranes.

Fulfillment & Payments: Client requires live courier integration (Fastway Couriers) over flat rates, and online payment options (Payflex BNPL and credit card gateways) to avoid reliance on manual EFT.
existingSiteFindings: Domain & DNS: The primary custom domain uproof.co.za is not yet pointed via DNS; current live site operates under https://teal-sparrow-432062.hostingersite.com/.
Catalog display issues: The /shop page shows 5 category tabs, but only one single product ('Liquid Rubber' at R790) is rendered on the page.

Homepage pricing and featured products: Featured cards for Bonding Liquid Primer (5L & 20L) display no price, while Fibre Filler 20L displays R500,00-conflicting directly with the client's master retail price list of R1590,00.

Address discrepancy: The live Contact page specifies 'Shop 5, Vision 21 Industrial Park, Steel Road, Duncanville, Vereeniging, 1929', whereas Creative Touch's 2026-09-02 audit recorded and set WooCommerce shipping origin to 'Unit 4, Gateway Industrial Park, 12 Grader Road, Sebenza, Edenvale, Johannesburg, 1609'.
Contact information: Includes a valid-format primary phone (+27 11 450 1234) alongside a placeholder number (+27100000000) in the header.
Navigation and Links: Multiple homepage Application 'Read more' links and featured product actions use placeholder fragment anchors ('#').

Page Builder & Technical Stack: Product metadata reveals 'Elementor 4.2.4', whereas prior audit recorded 10Web WVC builder engine; non-JS fetches returned empty body tags for product detail URLs, requiring headless/browser DOM verification.
Blog & Teasers: Homepage features placeholder articles with future publication dates (June 26, 2026) and admin author handle 'ctsa-admin'.
competitorInsights: No competitor research was performed in this research pass.
risks: Customer confusion and checkout errors resulting from conflicting business address details between the Contact page (Vereeniging) and WooCommerce store settings (Edenvale).
Financial loss or sales loss from display of incorrect pricing (e.g., Fibre Filler 20L listed at R500 instead of R1590) or unpriced product cards.
Reduced online conversions due to incomplete catalog rendering on the main Shop page where only 1 product displays out of 5 categories.
Potential trust erosion caused by placeholder telephone numbers (+27100000000), future-dated blog posts, and non-functional '#' links.
Checkout failures if payment gateways (Paystack/Payflex) and live shipping methods (Fastway) are not configured with active live credentials prior to domain cutover.
recommendations: Reconcile physical business address with client (Vereeniging vs. Edenvale) and align both WooCommerce shipping origin settings and Contact page content.
Correct catalog query/display settings in WooCommerce so that all product categories, variations, and correct prices (matching the master price list) display on /shop and homepage.
Update featured product cards to link to real product URLs and display validated pricing (fix Fibre Filler 20L to R1590).
Remove placeholder phone number (+27100000000) and replace or hide placeholder blog posts/authors prior to launch.
Complete live credentialing and API configuration for Paystack, Payflex, and Fastway Couriers shipping integration.
Perform full rendered browser/visual testing on WooCommerce product detail pages to verify Elementor template rendering.
Execute official DNS migration connecting uproof.co.za once staging audit and human QA sign-off are completed.

knowledge.title: Every build passes through the safety pipeline
knowledge.content: BUILD -> PREVIEW -> HUMAN DESIGN APPROVAL -> QA -> FINAL REGRESSION AUDIT -> CONTROLLED ACTIVATION TESTING -> HUMAN LAUNCH APPROVAL -> LIVE. No stage may be skipped by an agent.

knowledge.title: GREEN / AMBER / RED permission tiers
knowledge.content: GREEN actions run automatically. AMBER actions require explicit human approval before execution. RED actions (DNS, registrar, payment credentials, destructive infrastructure) are never executed by an agent without explicit, named authorization.

knowledge.title: Launch never auto-approves
knowledge.content: QA at zero is necessary, never sufficient, for launch. Launch requires human approval; approving with open launch holds is a deliberate, recorded human decision.

knowledge.title: Agents propose; humans approve knowledge
knowledge.content: Agents may propose lesson candidates. No agent may promote its own output into AGENCY or DOCTRINE knowledge. Human approval is the only path from CANDIDATE to APPROVED.

knowledge.title: U-Proof prior Creative Touch audit history (as of 2026-09-02)
knowledge.content: Creative Touch's own prior hands-on technical audit history for this project (most recent pass 2026-09-02): no shipping zones/methods configured (test order confirmed silent no-shipping checkout, since deleted); only BACS/Cheque/COD enabled, Paystack/Payflex installed but never configured with real credentials; compiled Shop/Product/Cart/Checkout build files were found hardcoding a third-party 10Web trial domain (allowed-pony.10web.cloud) for logo/breadcrumb/footer/payment-icon assets, confirmed live and customer-facing as of 2026-09-02, then stripped from on-disk build files in a housekeeping pass (not independently re-verified live since); a fake 'recent articles' teaser section (FAQs, How to Apply Liquid Rubber, Surface Preparation Guide) on the homepage links to non-existent pages, left from an earlier AI-generated clone; real broken homepage CTA links were found and fixed; a placeholder-style phone number pattern (+27100000000) was noted; WooCommerce shipping-origin address was corrected to match the Contact page's address at the time (Unit 4, Gateway Industrial Park, Sebenza, Edenvale, Johannesburg); order-notification emails were going to Creative Touch's own address rather than the client's business inbox, and the outgoing from-address was a leftover third-party domain - both flagged, not resolved; security hardening was applied (headers, stripped version-disclosure tags, removed exposed backup files); real Size and Size x Color variation structures were built and verified for Liquid Rubber, Fibre Filler, Wall & Roof Paint and Membrane with real pricing. None of this should be assumed still accurate without checking fresh evidence - several items already appear to have changed.

knowledge.title: U-Proof business context
knowledge.content: The client (Martin) owns a South African waterproofing/building-products company, U-Proof. Creative Touch is rebuilding/completing the company's ecommerce website on WordPress + WooCommerce after a prior developer relationship broke down without a proper handover. The client likes the existing design and wants it completed and improved, not redesigned. The client does not want manual/flat-rate shipping and prefers live courier rates (Fastway Couriers); Payflex (SA buy-now-pay-later) was under evaluation alongside a standard card gateway, because the client does not want EFT/manual payment as the primary path.
